Package sootup.callgraph.invokedynamic

Interface DynamicInvokeResolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
BootstrapMethodHandleResolver
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface DynamicInvokeResolver
Decides which methods an invokedynamic call site transfers control to. Shared by CHA, RTA, Spark and Qilin (configured via CallGraphConfigBuilder.dynamicInvokeResolver(...)), so all algorithms agree on which lambda bodies / method references are reachable.

Edges to the returned targets are attributed to the invokedynamic statement itself, not to the later functional-interface call site. Pointer analyses bind the call site's arguments (the captured values) as DynamicInvokeTarget.captureParameterIndex(int) says; no return value flows back, since the invokedynamic produces the functional object, not the target's result.
